files.content: # Theme toggle > Controlled theme controls with a three-value switch, binary switch, cycle button, and dropdown. This file matches the installed `theme-toggle-block` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/theme-toggle-block.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/theme-toggle-block.md`. ## npm dependencies - `lucide-react@^1.47.0` ## Registry dependencies - `button` - `core` - `dropdown-menu` - `switch` - `typography` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/blocks/theme-toggle`: `ThemeSwitch`, `ThemeSegmentedSwitch`, `ThemeToggle`, `ThemeDropdown`, types `ThemeMode`, `ThemeToggleOption`, `ThemeToggleProps`, `ThemeSwitchProps`, `ThemeSegmentedSwitchProps`, `ThemeDropdownProps` ## Composition ### Three-way choice ```tsx ``` ### Binary choice ```tsx ``` ### Cycle button ```tsx
